title: Fig in the Sun
note: b382 — page 3 ('Fig is a red bug') uses the heat_tint prop as a translucent warm wash OVER Fig rather than recolouring his own cast geometry, which the cast-identity check forbids (his core must be byte-identical in every book). See DEPARTURES.md.

pages.brief: Fig the green striped caterpillar stretched along the top of a large mossy log, all his little legs in a neat row. Detailed bark texture.
pages.alt: Fig the green striped caterpillar is stretched along the top of a large mossy log, all his little legs in a neat row.

pages.brief: The sun drawn large and hot at the top of the page, the log and Fig small below in a pool of hard light. Strong shadows.
pages.alt: The sun is drawn large and hot at the top of the page, with the log and Fig small below it in a pool of hard light.

pages.brief: Fig warmed to a deep sunset red by the heat, still stripy underneath, looking slightly alarmed at his own colour. Funny.
pages.alt: Fig has been warmed to a deep sunset red by the heat, still stripy underneath, looking slightly alarmed at his own colour.

pages.brief: Fig fast asleep on the log, curled into a comma shape, legs relaxed. Peaceful, warm, close-cropped.
pages.alt: Fig is fast asleep on the log, curled into a comma shape with his legs relaxed, peaceful and warm.

pages.brief: Pip landing on the log with a bump, tail up, waking the whole log. Fig jolting awake mid-frame.
pages.alt: Pip lands on the log with a bump, tail up, waking the whole log, while Fig jolts awake mid-frame.

pages.brief: Pip nudging Fig with one wing while Fig grips the bark with all his legs, refusing to move. Comic tug of war.
pages.alt: Pip nudges Fig with one wing while Fig grips the bark with all his legs, refusing to move — a comic tug of war.

pages.brief: Fig mid-tantrum, reared up, all legs waving, small and furious. Draw the fuss as bigger than the caterpillar.
pages.alt: Fig is mid-tantrum, reared up with all his legs waving, small and furious — the fuss drawn bigger than the caterpillar himself.

pages.brief: Closing page: the two of them side by side on the log in the low evening sun, calm again, long shadows behind them.
pages.alt: Closing page: Pip and Fig sit side by side on the log in the low evening sun, calm again, with long shadows behind them.
